notes: Small additive review-audit build. Makes formal controlled-document review history visible in Document details, including review date/time, reviewer, outcome, next review date and note for RA/COSHH RA/SSW and other non-SDS controlled documents. Adds the same formal controlled-review workflow and immutable audit history for approved Toolbox Talks, including Reviewed/no change, New version required and Other action outcomes. A no-change review updates the next review date without creating a fake new version; action-required reviews flag the current TBT for follow-up while keeping its existing controlled record/history. Supabase migration training_controlled_reviews_v21056 applied. This is phase 1 only; linked RA/COSHH impact review/modify actions, refresher-method controls and ad-hoc retraining remain for the next small builds. Includes v2.10.55 and earlier fixes.
